limits: Diagnostic sample, not a load test or SLO estimate
First diagnostic request is not a verified cold start
Cloudflare performance.now is I/O-driven; zero durations do not prove zero CPU
Single selected resolver makes runtime phase subtraction meaningful; do not add maxima across multiple apps
